svg.aria-label: What's in the box for W5. The objective is to prove Workforce is shippable, shown as three proving surfaces stacked in a box. First, the reference app: the kitchen-sink upgraded so a cloned app hires a durable team, opens channels and boards, and still has them after a redeploy. It has a producer, the held child epic FIX-1455. Second, the live view: devtool improved so a run is observed as it unfolds across channels and workers, rather than reconstructed from a trace afterwards. It is drawn as an empty slot marked no child, because nothing in the set produces it. Third, the real configuration: a basic DevForce running one genuine task through a workforce end to end, watched doing it. It is also an empty slot marked no child; its first build slice, FIX-1426, is done, but basically working has no owner. Beneath the three sits the one running thing they are all views of: the living assembly, which is durable hire, channels, CHANNEL.md seats, boards and inventory; agent isolation, where read-only handbooks are ambient down the org, team and worker tree while mutable resources need an explicit grant, which is FIX-1467's exploration; and park and answer, where an agent seat parks a row with a reason and the person answers through a flow action carrying the request's own principal. A boundary line under the box reads: one user, one org. Agents are isolated from each other, not people from people. To the right, composed in by the app: its own channel kinds as CHANNEL.md flow factories rather than new L1, and its own rendering of Waiting-on-you which never adds a status value. Below that, consumed and not owned: the W3 floor, FIX-1351, landed, and the W4 first cut, FIX-1407, landed. Below that a note says the set is open and more children are expected, per rule ER-23. Then a band headed grow into later, deferred and not refused, revisited when multi-user or sign-off pain is real, containing: multi-user with more than one principal; the org chart of people as a product; originator not equal to reviewer; a durable reviewedBy bind; the FIX-1455 bind requirements the canceled explore would have handed down; multi-principal walls covering one person across many desks, whether channel members are principals, and where a board lives once several principals reach it; and CyberForce. Finally, below a fence, what is not built: no Human, Team, Channel or Agent as an L1 type; no parallel HITL plane and no human-only side boards; no merged board-assignee and seat registry; no new L1 TaskStatus for Waiting-on-you or Idle, including to render a devtool column; no Collab RC as this epic; no kitchen-sink-only APIs, kitchen-sink-only store or in-memory-only hire; no Lab product inside the kitchen-sink, though DevForce now runs beside it; no seats plugged into supervisor or patterns factories as L2 primitives; no nested sessions as the work control plane; no second skill registry and no second memory story; and no multi-human machinery, which is deferred rather than refused.

g.text: IN THE BOX — PROVE WORKFORCE IS SHIPPABLE, ON THREE SURFACES
1 · THE REFERENCE APP — FIX-1455, ITS OWN LIFECYCLE
clone it, it hires a team, and still has it after a redeploy
durable hire · CHANNEL.md seats · channels · boards · inventory
2 · THE LIVE VIEW — NO CHILD
watch the run unfold in devtool, not a trace read afterwards
channels · workers · the activity moving between them
3 · THE REAL CONFIGURATION — NO CHILD
a basic DevForce runs one genuine task, end to end
first build slice FIX-1426 is done — “basically working” has no owner
ALL THREE ARE VIEWS OF ONE RUNNING THING
the living assembly — durable hire · channels · seats · boards · inventory
agent isolation — references/ ambient RO by tree · resources/ by grant · FIX-1467
park and answer — the seat parks; the person answers with the request’s own principal
BOUNDARY · ONE USER, ONE ORG — agents isolated from each other, not people
COMPOSED IN BY THE APP
its own channel kinds
CHANNEL.md · flow factories, not new L1
its own Waiting-on-you rendering
a view over parked + reason; never a status
CONSUMED, NOT OWNED
W3 floor · FIX-1351 — landed
W4 first cut · FIX-1407 — landed
THE SET IS OPEN — more children expected
filing one is normal course, not a re-scope · ER-23
GROW INTO LATER — DEFERRED, NOT REFUSED · revisit when multi-user or sign-off pain is real
multi-user (a second principal) · the org chart of people as a product · originator ≠ reviewer · durable reviewedBy:
the FIX-1455 bind requirements the canceled explore would have handed down · multi-principal walls · CyberForce
NOT BUILT
no Human / Team / Channel / Agent as an L1 type · no parallel HITL plane · no human-only side boards
no merged board-assignee + seat registry · no new L1 TaskStatus for Waiting-on-you or Idle, not even for a devtool column
no Collab RC as this epic · no KS-only APIs / KS-only store / in-memory-only hire · no person as a board drainer
no Lab product inside the kitchen-sink — DevForce runs beside it, never in it · no seats in supervisor() or patterns factories
no nested sessions as control plane · no second skill or memory story · no multi-human machinery (deferred above, not refused)
